summary: Reserved-capacity prorate credits not applied after cross-region rollback and autoscale
description: Issue summary: Brightline Health reports that their March 1-3 reserved-capacity prorated credits did not appear on the finalized invoice (INV-2026-03-01-9001). Impact: customer sees a $18,420 overcharge on a finalized invoice affecting accounting close and renewal negotiations. Environment: Dedicated reserved pools in us-east and eu-west with cross-region fallback enabled; private control plane via VPC. Observed behavior: during an automated cross-region rollback (us-east -> eu-west) caused by a hardware preemption event at 2026-03-01T03:17:00Z, a subsequent autoscale rollback and reconciler window adjustment coincided with delayed postbacks. The hourly prorated reserved credits that should have applied for the 02:00-04:00 UTC window were not applied, leaving warmup and reserved-hour credits unallocated and billed at hosted rates. Customer requests a detailed audit, provisional credit, and confirmation of permanent fix.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Have active reserved capacity in two regions with cross-region fallback enabled (us-east primary, eu-west fallback).
2) Trigger a preemption/maintenance causing autoscale rollback (simulate GPU preempt at 03:10 UTC).
3) Allow the reconciler postback window to roll over while autoscaler triggers a canary rollback.
4) Generate hourly postbacks for the affected window and finalize invoice. Observe missing prorate credits.
logs: postback-reconciler: 2026-03-01T03:30:12Z ERROR shard-17: failed to ack window 2026-03-01T02:00Z-03:00Z - timeout, retry queued (trace: pb-98431)
scheduler: 2026-03-01T03:16:59Z INFO autoscaler: rollback initiated for pool-resv-39 due to host preempt (host-id: i-0a3b8).
billing-processor: 2026-03-01T04:05:01Z WARN invoice-finalizer: postbacks missing for tenant brightline-prod for windows [02:00-04:00 UTC], applying fallback hosted rate
investigation_notes: Initial triage: Support validated invoice lines and timestamps; confirmed missing prorate credit line. (Avery) 2026-03-10
Reconciler logs show a retry storm and a single shard failing to checkpoint; leads to postback omission for tenant tag brightline-prod. (Eng/SRE) 2026-03-11

Hypothesis: race between autoscale rollback and postback reconciler window flush caused postbacks to be marked as stale and not ingested into billing pipeline. Also observed a clock skew of ~9s on shard-17 which crossed our 5s anti-dup window. (Riley) 2026-03-11

Confirmed: postbacks exist on S3 raw-store for the windows but were not picked up by the billing aggregator due to a reconciler index gap introduced by PR #842 which changed window boundary behavior during rollbacks. (Billing eng) 2026-03-12
comments: Avery Chen (Support) 2026-03-10: Logged on behalf of Brightline Finance — customer needs provisional credit ASAP, accounting close this week.
Riley Patel (SRE) 2026-03-11: Reconciler shard-17 shows repeated timeouts; raising INT-3342 to investigate shard stability across region failovers.

Tara Moreno (Billing) 2026-03-11: Able to locate raw postbacks in S3 for tenant brightline-prod. Missing from billing-aggregator ingestion window from 03:00-03:30 UTC. Will attempt manual ingest/backfill.
Brightline Finance (Customer) 2026-03-11: Requesting an itemized audit and a provisional credit equal to the missed prorate lines while you investigate.
action_items: 1) Billing: perform manual backfill ingest for postbacks from S3 for windows 02:00-04:00 UTC for brightline-prod and re-run invoice aggregation. (Owner: Tara)
2) SRE: investigate shard-17 clock skew and add a 10s safety buffer to reconciler anti-dup window. (Owner: Riley, due 2026-03-13)
3) Eng: revert or patch PR #842 to prevent window boundary changes during rollbacks; add tests for cross-region rollback path. (Owner: Eng Release, due 2026-03-14)
4) Support: apply provisional credit to customer account and notify finance and customer. (Owner: Avery, done 2026-03-12)
5) Postmortem: capture incident timeline and update Reserved Capacity Prorate SOP with rollback edge-cases. (Owner: OPS)
resolution: Provisional credit applied; manual backfill scheduled; reconciler fix in progress
resolution_notes: On 2026-03-12 Support applied a provisional credit of $18,420 to Brightline Health to cover the missing prorate credits pending final invoice reconciliation. Billing engineer Tara performed a manual backfill ingest of the raw postbacks and re-ran the invoice aggregation in a staging environment; results show prorate lines reconcile correctly after ingestion. SRE identified a 9s clock skew on shard-17 causing anti-dup window misclassification and a reconciler index gap introduced by PR #842. A patch has been merged to add a safety buffer for rollback scenarios and to ensure reconciler window boundaries are stable during autoscale events (PR referenced above). We will confirm final invoice adjustment before close of business 2026-03-15 and provide Brightline with an itemized audit export. Follow-ups: INT-3342 shard stability investigation and OPS postmortem scheduled.
customer_desired_outcome: Full audit export (CSV) of postback and billing lines for 2026-03-01 00:00-06:00 UTC, reversal or credit equal to missing prorate lines, and confirmation changes deployed to prevent recurrence.
